contractDeltas.problem: Runtime pins WW=WH=200, TILE=16 (40,000 cells); Veyra is 250x175 source cells of 8 authoring units (43,750 cells) on a 2000x1400 canvas.
contractDeltas.requiredDelta: Approve and document an explicit authoring-unit -> runtime-tile transform (or relax the fixed extent). Supply measured journey times with the scale decision. Map will not silently rescale.

contractDeltas.problem: moisture and temperature must be finite 0..1 per cell with no UNKNOWN representation; Veyra defines no climate.
contractDeltas.requiredDelta: Add a climate sub-contract with an explicit unknown/undefined state (e.g. climateStatus + separate optional arrays), or let Gameplay supply climate. Map will not fabricate plausible numbers.

contractDeltas.problem: biome must be one of 14 Gameplay strings; Veyra has 12 raw codes with NO legend embedded in the canonical JSON. MAP-GEO-02 found the 12-name legend in the pinned Map Lab v3 reference source, but it is on a different branch, not approved, and code 0 doubles as a sea sentinel.
contractDeltas.requiredDelta: Approve + embed the source-derived 12-code legend with a land/sea guard, approve a 12->14 Biome mapping (and an UNKNOWN member if partial coverage is allowed), then a verified transform. Never infer the legend from colour/appearance.

contractDeltas.problem: Requires entrances, rooms, doors, powerNodes, hazardCells, loot sites, retreatPaths, widthTiles, cargoPassable and criticalPaths — none authored in Veyra. MAP-GEO-01 wrongly classified POI rooms/entrances as Gameplay-owned.
contractDeltas.requiredDelta: SPLIT BY CREATOR ARCHITECTURE: physical POI rooms, entrances, passages, door openings, interior circulation, spatial sockets and retreat paths are MAP responsibilities even when NOT_IN_SOURCE (GEO-02 supplies a PROPOSED, non-canonical candidate for po_kilns). Locked states, loot, power, hazard intensity and interactions remain GAMEPLAY responsibilities. Do not require Map to fabricate Gameplay fields, and do not require Gameplay to author physical geometry.

contractDeltas.problem: A single validator calls compileEconomy + diagnoseStarts, i.e. Gameplay population, inside Map geometry validation.
contractDeltas.requiredDelta: Two-stage validation: (1) Map geometry integrity; (2) Gameplay population/placement diagnostics after Gameplay has run. Map must not run Gameplay population to pass a validator.

contractDeltas.problem: zone array allows 0..15; Veyra authors 23 buildable zone ids.
contractDeltas.requiredDelta: Widen the zone id space or approve an explicit zone remap. No remap was invented here.

contractDeltas.problem: Veyra roads have no width field; validator requires an integer 1..32 and tests its cross-section.
contractDeltas.requiredDelta: Either approve an authored width per road class (a joint decision) or allow widthStatus=UNKNOWN with a relaxed width check. Map keeps width NOT_IN_SOURCE.

contractDeltas.problem: Hardcoded slope > 0.6 impassable threshold; Map slope was a raw byte gradient with no unit. MAP-GEO-02 resolved the source unit: hypot(d(elev/255)/dx, d(elev/255)/dy) x 100 in abstract authoring units (a Map Lab heuristic, NOT a Bible value).
contractDeltas.requiredDelta: Define a jointly approved normalization + threshold; expose it as a Gameplay rule, not a Map constant. Map Lab thresholds (buildSlopeMax 0.5 / cartSlopeMax 0.7 / footSlopeMax 1.5) are editor heuristics only.

contractDeltas.problem: Runtime requires six catalog Elder ids; Veyra has six distinct named Elder territories with different identities.
contractDeltas.requiredDelta: Approve an explicit identity mapping (or a new runtime Elder catalog). No six fake Elder mappings were created.

contractDeltas.problem: Veyra project.terrain.seed=2026 is a terrain authoring seed, not a world/runtime seed.
contractDeltas.requiredDelta: Keep package seed Gameplay-owned; do not reuse the terrain seed as world seed.

contractDeltas.problem: 8 Veyra ferry paths are water routes with UNDEFINED boarding rules; runtime road raster is land-only.
contractDeltas.requiredDelta: Add an explicit waterRoute / ferry concept with Gameplay boat rules; never flatten ferry into a land road.

contractDeltas.problem: Validator requires a nonboss cash static above escrowChestPrice and matching door/gen/loot statics.
contractDeltas.requiredDelta: Gameplay supplies all economy entities. Map supplies only POI shells and candidate site ids.

twoStageIntegrationSeam.joint: Approved transform + measured journey times + approved biome mapping + slope normalization + road width policy, then a versioned RuntimeMapPackage.
twoStageIntegrationSeam.note: Do not build a RuntimeMapPackage from dummy data to make the validator pass.
